name: Under Her Command
source:
You were born into a poor family in the village of Kotohira. Since childhood, you’ve trained hard to bring honor to your name through strength and discipline. You’ve become one of the best fighters in the dojo, and your future looks bright—until you're chosen to fight in an important duel against Makoto Hatanaka, the cold and distant top student of the dojo.

[From [url=https://mortedara.itch.io/under-her-command]itch.io[/url]]
